title: Zulm Baad e Mustafa Sadaat Pey Kya Hogeya
body:
Zakhmi Masjid Mey Dukhi x2 Zainab Ka Baba Hogeya
<<DIVIDER>>
Dhaurti Aati Thi Zainab Phir Rahi Thi Jaa Baja
Sani e Zahra Ke Dil Par x2 Hashr Barpa Hogeya
<<DIVIDER>>
Momino Ansu Bahao Pursa Do Hasnain Ko x2
Aj Kufa Mey Qatal x2 Kabay Ka Kaba Hogeya
<<DIVIDER>>
Ey Khuda Tujhko Mubarak Tera Ye Mah e Sayyam x 2
Jismey Zainab Lutgayi x2 Aur Deen Zinda Hogeya
<<DIVIDER>>
Chotey Bachay Kya Karey Maula Tere Janay Ke Baad x2
Fatima Zahra Ka Ghar x2 Duniya Mey Tanha Hogeya
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindagi Akthar Guzarey Bankey Tera Nohakhawn x2
Pak Bibi Ye Mera x2 Armaan Pura Hogeya
